description: Deterministic structural quality linter for user stories - a sibling to ticket_lint but scoped to story-writing concepts any team recognizes: narrative completeness (As-a/I-want-to/So-that/Summary), acceptance criteria presence, duplicate/unknown dependency IDs, a "Manage X" story with no CRUD split, list stories missing a pagination mention. An OPTIONAL rate_config unlocks team-specific checks (screen-vs-narrative match, hour-rate-per-screen tolerance, required risk level by story type, milestone-code format, required companion story types per milestone) - omit it and only the universal checks run. No house rates or milestone conventions are hardcoded. POST one story or a batch (max 50). Deterministic, no LLM.

rate_config.description: Optional. Enables team-specific checks, all off by default.

check_screen_match.description: Flag when story.on_screen disagrees with story.screen.

milestone_code_pattern.description: Regex the milestone_code field must match.

rates.description: Per type_label: {hours_field, hours_per_screen, tolerance?}. Flags hours[hours_field] that deviate from screens * hours_per_screen by more than tolerance (default 0.15).

required_companion_types.description: Batch-level only: for each milestone group (milestone_code prefix before the first "-"), flag if no story has this type_label.

label.description: Name used in the finding. Default: type.

risk_required_types.description: type_labels that must carry a valid risk level.

stories.description: Alternative: batch of up to 50 stories. Dependency/duplicate/required-companion checks are evaluated across the whole batch.

story.description: One user story. Missing fields ARE findings.

acceptance_criteria.description: A list, or one string with one criterion per line.

dependencies.description: Ids of stories this depends on; must exist in the batch.

id.description: Story id; what dependencies refer to.

milestone_code.description: e.g. "M2-07"; the part before the first "-" is the milestone group.

screen.description: Screens touched, one per line; the line count is the screen count.

story.description: The narrative. as_a, i_want_to, so_that and summary are all expected.

on_screen.description: Screen name, compared to screen when check_screen_match is on.

type_label.description: Story type; keys rate_config.rates and risk rules.

name: story_lint
